raw.title: Product Design Manager
raw.description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

We're looking for an experienced design manager to lead our Product Design team.

This is a management role. Your job is to develop designers, raise the quality of the work, and make sure design has real influence on where the product goes. It is not a player-coach role, and it is not a step up for a strong IC looking for their first management position. We need someone who has already managed product designers and can do it well from day one.

n8n is a powerful, flexible technical tool, which means the problems your team tackles are complex. Design decisions have to account for diverse user workflows, technical constraints, and how changes ripple across the whole platform. You'll need enough craft depth to recognise excellent work, challenge it constructively, and help designers get better. The team needs a manager whose design judgment they trust.

You'll manage a team spanning product designers, design engineers and user researchers at a range of seniority levels, working across our product areas. You'll work alongside our other design manager. You'll report to our VP of Product until our Head of Design joins the team. That search is running now.

More than 80% of workflows built on n8n involve AI agents, and we're widening from a developer audience to a broader set of builders. That shift is the central design problem here, and your team is at the centre of it.

🎯 Your main goal is to build a Product Design team that consistently produces excellent work and shapes how n8n's product evolves. Here's what that involves:


Lead and develop the team

  • Run regular, high-quality 1:1s and coach designers, design engineers and researchers across different levels.

  • Own performance management: evidence-based reviews, honest feedback, and real support for anyone who isn't where they need to be.

  • Help people understand what's expected at their level and what growth looks like, evolving our progression framework for Product Design.

  • Hire excellent designers as the team grows, and broaden the range of backgrounds and perspectives on the team.

Raise the design bar

  • Set and hold a high standard across problem framing, user understanding, interaction design, information architecture and visual craft.

  • Facilitate design critiques and reviews that measurably improve the work, and help designers think beyond the feature in front of them.

  • Develop designers' judgment and autonomy rather than becoming the final approval layer for every decision.

Own the whole product experience

  • Keep a holistic view across features and product areas, identifying inconsistencies, recurring UX problems, and opportunities for more coherent patterns.

  • Work with the team to address fragmentation systematically rather than feature by feature.

Make design a real partner

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering leadership so design contributes early to problem definition and product direction, not late to execution.

  • Help designers influence product decisions through strong reasoning rather than positional authority.

  • Improve how the team works across critique, collaboration, decision-making and knowledge sharing, introducing structure where it helps the team scale and resisting process that slows things down.

How much of this is hands-on?

Worth being direct, because it's the question every good candidate asks. This is a management role: developing designers, raising the bar, and making design count in product decisions is the job, and that's where your time goes.

You'll stay close to the craft in critiques, in reviews and in the detail of the work, and you'll occasionally pick up design work yourself. When that happens it sits outside the squads and varies with the period: an exploratory concept, a gap during someone's leave, a problem that needs a first pass. It is not a 50/50 split, and if what you want is to keep a squad's worth of delivery alongside managing the team, this isn't the role.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 👥 Proven design management: You've managed product designers in a product-led technology company for 3+ years, with a team of five or more. This is not a first management role.

  • 🧭 Running a team well: You've run effective 1:1s, evidence-based performance reviews and difficult feedback conversations, including with people who weren't performing. You've built or improved a career progression framework for designers, and you're comfortable with the administrative side of managing a team rather than treating it as overhead.

  • 📈 Growing people: You coach and mentor, you run critique that changes the work, and you can point to specific designers who got measurably better or grew in scope while reporting to you.

  • 🎨 Design taste and judgment: Your own craft is strong enough that designers trust your read on quality, you can articulate what separates adequate design from excellent design, and you'll step into the work directly when the situation calls for it.

  • 🎯 Hiring: You've hired designers consistently well, you know where good design talent is and how to attract it, and you can tell the difference quickly.

  • 🤖 AI fluency: You use AI tools hands-on in your own work and in how your team designs, and you have an informed view on designing AI-enabled products. AI agents are the product here, so this one is not optional.

Nice-to-haves

  • 🛠️ Technical products: You've managed design teams in B2B SaaS, developer tools, workflow automation or similarly technical products.

  • 🧠 Technical mindset: You don't need to write code, but genuine curiosity about what's happening underneath (APIs, webhooks, data structures, how workflows actually execute) earns you credibility with engineers here.

  • 👩‍💻 Designing for developers: You've designed products for developers, technical operators or other sophisticated users.

  • 🔭 Systems view: You can step back from individual projects to spot patterns and UX problems across a broader product experience.

  • 🤝 Influence without authority: You bring Product and Engineering peers with you through reasoning rather than positional authority.

  • 📊 Scaling teams: You've grown a design team through a period of rapid company growth.

  • 🌍 Distributed teams: You've managed designers in remote-first or highly distributed organisations.

  • 🔓 Open source: You've worked on open-source or community-driven products.

  • 🌱 Inclusive hiring: You've meaningfully broadened the diversity of a design team through how you hire.

Our hiring process

We'll tell you the whole shape of it upfront, and there's very little homework.

  1. Screening call with our recruiter. 45 minutes, no prep.

  2. Leading designers with the hiring manager, 75 minutes. You'll present for 20 minutes on a team you built, grew or turned around. Reuse existing material; it shouldn't take more than two or three hours. We don't need case studies of your own design work.

  3. Live critique and coaching, 60 minutes. We'll send you a real piece of n8n design work 24 hours ahead. You'll critique it, then have a coaching conversation with the designer who made it. No preparation beyond reading it and trying the product.

  4. Conversation with our VP of Product, and a culture call with Jan, our CEO. 45 minutes each, same day where we can.

  5. Meet two or three of the designers you'd be managing. Not scored; it's for you as much as for us.

We'll also ask for two references, one of them a former direct report. A portfolio is welcome if you have one, though we know not every design manager keeps theirs current.

Why join us?

At n8n, your work won't disappear into a slide deck. You'll lead design for a product that hundreds of thousands of builders use to automate real work, sitting right where developer tools, AI agents and no-code interaction models meet. The design problems are genuinely hard and largely unsolved.

You're inheriting an established team with strong designers, not building from zero, and there's real room to shape how the team coaches, critiques, grows and works with Product and Engineering, rather than inheriting a rigid design organisation. You'll stay close enough to the craft to influence quality directly, while your main job is making the designers around you better.

You'll join a fast-growing, Europe remote-first company where autonomy, experimentation, and craft matter, at the point where n8n is scaling from a beloved open-source project into a major B2B platform. Design's contribution to product thinking is established here, and has a long way still to run.

Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?

Apply now and help us build the future of automation.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

  • Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:

    • Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.

    • US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.

  • Health & wellness 🩺 –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.

  • Future planning 💰 –

    • Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.*

    • US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match.

  • Financial security 🛡️ –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones.

  • Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.

  • A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!

  • Remote-first 🌏 – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description.

  • Giving back 🤝 – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about.

  • Transparency 🙏 – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang.

*Country and/or State specific details provided in your employment agreement.

title: Senior AI Content Producer - Foto, Video, Motion (m/w/d)
description: Bei Rosental Organics bist du kein klassischer Fotograf oder Videograf – du bist der Content Multiplier. Ein Shoot wird bei dir zu 50+ Assets, ein UGC-Clip zu 30 Hook-Variants, ein Produktfoto zu 20 Format-Adaptionen. Der Meta-Algorithmus belohnt Volumen und Diversität, und genau das lieferst du: aus einer Kampagne wird bei dir ein ganzer Wochen-Feed für Paid Social. Du produzierst und multiplizierst Foto-, Video- und Motion-Content für Paid Ads, Social, CRM und E-Commerce, mit klarem Fokus auf Performance und Testing-Volumen. Du drehst und shootest schnell und hands-on mit modernem Setup: UGC, Product, Lifestyle, Studio – End-to-End und ohne Assistenz-Kette. Einen skalierbaren AI-Workflow baust du selbst auf, der Rohmaterial in Dutzende testbare Variants verwandelt: Hook-Iterations, Cutdowns, Format-Adaptions, Kontext-Wechsel, Voiceover-Varianten, Motion-Loops. Du entwickelst High-Performing Creatives für Meta, TikTok und CRM mit Fokus auf Hook Rate, Watchtime, CTR und ROAS. Mindestens 3 neue AI-Tools pro Jahr integrierst du produktiv in unseren Stack (Runway, Nano Banana, Kive, ElevenLabs, Topaz, CapCut AI, Descript – was heute liefert, ersetzt du morgen). Performance-Dashboards liest du selbst, ziehst die Insights und übersetzt sie am gleichen Tag in neue Variants und Hypothesen. Du bringst 3+ Jahre Erfahrung in Content Production für D2C/ E-Commerce, Performance Marketing oder ein hochdynamisches Growth-Umfeld mit, inklusive starker Paid-Social-Cases (Meta, TikTok). Dein Portfolio zeigt echte Performance-Ergebnisse (Hook Rate, Watchtime, CTR, ROAS) und Beispiele, wie du aus einem Asset viele gemacht hast, keine Editorial-Reels, keine Behance-Moodboards. Neue AI-Tools lernst du eigenständig und schnell: Runway, Nano Banana, Kive, ElevenLabs, CapCut AI, Descript und Topaz sind dir vertraut, und den nächsten Tool-Sprung hast du meist schon selbst identifiziert. Du drehst, shootest und schneidest selbst (≥ 85 %): Sony/Canon, Studio-Light und Natural-Light, Premiere Pro, CapCut, Photoshop und Lightroom auf sehr hohem Niveau, mit Meta-Funnel-Logik im Schlaf (Hooks Sek. 1, Pattern Interrupt, Pacing). Aus einem Shot 50 Assets zu machen, klingt für dich nach Chance statt Qualitätsverlust; Premium-Ästhetik ohne Kompromisse ist für dich selbstverständlich, AI-Output darf nie nach AI-Output aussehen. Du liest Zahlen und übersetzt sie direkt in Creative-Entscheidungen, strukturiert, direkt, belastbar. Deutsch mind. C1. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Das Gesicht unserer Brand auf TikTok
description: Manche Dinge muss man nicht erklären. TRIONE ist eine Luxury Lifestyle Brand für Accessoires und Schmuck, designed in Marbella. Japanische Seidenkordel, graviertes Gold, Details, die man erst auf den zweiten Blick entdeckt und dann nicht mehr vergisst. Unser ONE Armband ist kein Accessoire, es ist ein Statement für Menschen, die nicht laut sein müssen, um gesehen zu werden. Jetzt bringen wir TRIONE auf TikTok. Nicht mit Countdowns und Rabattcodes, sondern mit Ästhetik, Haltung und Geschichten. Mit Videos und ausgewählten Livestreams aus unserem eigenen Store, von unseren Events und von Orten, die so besonders sind wie unsere Pieces. Dafür suchen wir die Person, die unsere Welt vor der Kamera spürbar macht. Deine Rolle Du bist das Gesicht von TRIONE auf TikTok, in Videos und in Livestreams aus unserem Store, von exklusiven Events und luxuriösen Locations Du erzählst die Geschichten hinter unseren Pieces, nicht ihre Preise Du gestaltest mit uns Content, der sich anfühlt wie die Brand selbst: ruhig, ästhetisch, selbstbewusst Du bist dabei, wenn eine Brand ihre nächste Ebene erreicht Was dich ausmacht Natürliche Präsenz vor der Kamera Ein Auge für Ästhetik, Fashion und Details Du verstehst TikTok und weißt, was Menschen wirklich innehalten lässt Stil, Verlässlichkeit und sehr gutes Deutsch Was dich erwartet Sichtbarkeit als Gesicht einer Brand, die man nicht übersieht Einladungen zu unseren exklusiven Events und Zugang zu unserem Netzwerk aus Creatorn und Partnern Pieces aus unserer Kollektion Ein kleines Team, kurze Wege und echter Einfluss auf das, was entsteht Flexible Zeiten neben Uni oder Job Für wen Diese Stelle ist als Pflichtpraktikum ausgeschrieben und richtet sich an Studierende, die laut Studien- oder Prüfungsordnung ihrer Hochschule ein Pflichtpraktikum absolvieren müssen. Dafür bekommst du Pieces aus unserer Kollektion, Zugang zu unseren Events und eine Praktikumsbescheinigung für deine Hochschule. Start ist ab sofort. IT-Systemadministrator (m/w/d) – Dresden | Voll- oder Teilzeit | Homeoffice-Möglichkeit

Im Auftrag unseres Partnerunternehmens in Dresden suchen wir Sie zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als „IT-Systemadministrator (m/w/d)“.

Aufgaben

  • Als IT-Systemadministrator (m/w/d) betreuen und entwickeln Sie die bestehende IT-Infrastruktur und sorgen für einen zuverlässigen Betrieb der Systeme
  • Zudem administrieren Sie Windows- und Linux-Umgebungen sowie Active Directory und unterstützen bei der Betreuung virtualisierter Systeme
  • Darüber hinaus analysieren Sie technische Anforderungen und wirken bei der Einführung und Weiterentwicklung von IT-Lösungen mit
  • Zusätzlich unterstützen Sie beim Aufbau effizienter IT-Strukturen und entwickeln bestehende Prozesse nutzerorientiert weiter
  • Dabei übernehmen Sie eigenverantwortlich IT-Projekte und arbeiten eng mit internen Fachbereichen und weiteren IT-Ansprechpartnern zusammen

Qualifikation

  • Grundlage bildet ein Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einer vergleichbaren IT-Fachrichtung bzw. eine gleichwertige Qualifikation mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung
  • Sie bringen mehrjährige Erfahrung als IT-Systemadministrator (m/w/d), Systemadministrator (m/w/d) oder IT-Administrator (m/w/d) in der Betreuung von IT-Infrastrukturen mit
  • Wichtig sind praktische Kenntnisse in Windows, Linux, Active Directory und Virtualisierung sowie ein breites Verständnis gängiger IT-Technologien
  • Zusätzlich bringen Sie erste Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von IT-Strukturen und nutzerorientierten Prozessen sowie gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse mit
  • Sie überzeugen durch Eigeninitiative, eine selbstständige und teamorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie Freude daran, IT-Projekte und Verbesserungen aktiv voranzutreiben

Benefits

  • Work-Life-Balance: Freuen Sie sich auf flexible Arbeitszeiten mit einer anteiligen Homeoffice-Möglichkeit
  • Sicherheit: Langfristige Jobmöglichkeit im Öffentlichen Dienst
  • Weiterentwicklung: Zahlreiche Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
  • Vielseitigkeit: Freuen Sie sich aufspannende und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeiten in einem dynamischen Umfeld

title: AVP, Data, Analytics & AI Engineering
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.</p> <p>What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.</p> <p style="padding-left: 40px;">Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.</p> <p style="padding-left: 40px;">Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating<em> </em>our wins – big and small.</p> <p>Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, <a href="https://www.anaplan.com/careers/">values</a>-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!</p></div><p><strong>About the Role:</strong></p> <p>The AVP, Data, Analytics &amp; AI Engineering is the executive leader responsible for the strategic vision, architecture, development, and scaling of our enterprise data platforms and AI solutions. This individual will lead a team tasked with turning enterprise data assets into high-performance, compliant, and secure intelligence frameworks that drive automation and strategic decision-making across the entire company. The role bridges the gap between modern cloud data stack engineering and emerging AI paradigms (like LLMOps and Agentic workflows). This individual will ensure that Anaplan engineering standards drive direct, measurable business value while maintaining top-tier data security, governance and responsible AI practices.</p> <p><strong>Your Impact</strong></p> <p>This is a critical role that requires an executive and organizational leader with a high degree of enterprise transformation leadership, discretion, and the ability to lead multiple priorities in a fast-paced, sales-driven, SaaS environment. This individual will work directly with the CFO, CRO, CHRO, CIO and Product leaders while building a high-performance engineering team.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Create <strong>Advanced Analytics/Decision Intelligence</strong> driving predictive analytics, propensity, forecasting, experimentation, causal thinking, optimization.</li> <li><strong>GenAI/Agent Engineering </strong>that is essential to the enterprise agent strategy – MCP, RAG, embeddings/vector search, tool calling, agent architecture, evaluation, grounding, orchestration. Architect and govern the Enterprise Agentic AI Strategy, deploying multi-agent frameworks and LLM-powered tools at scale.</li> <li>Architect and deploy enterprise-grade multi-agent AI systems for complex, multi-step workflows, integrating with ERP, CRM, and ITSM to automate high-value decisions end-to-end.</li> <li>Design internal AI tools and agents (e.g., AI Finance Bot, domain-specific LLM applications) and lead the roadmap for next-generation agentic platforms as emerging capabilities mature.</li> <li>Drive&nbsp;<strong>Data Governance &amp; AI Readiness</strong> – quality, lineage, observability, catalog, access controls, PII, retention, AI data governance.</li> <li>Provide business context to a&nbsp;<strong>Semantic &amp; Context Architecture</strong> with metrics layer, business ontology, entity relationships, metadata, knowledge graphs/semantic models.</li> <li><strong>Scale the team</strong> – build, mentor, motivate and lead high-performance team across Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering and AI Engineering.</li> <li><strong>Partner collaboratively&nbsp;</strong>with business units, product teams, security, legal and compliance teams to deliver AI and data solutions that align to enterprise goals.</li> <li>Drive Anaplan beyond pipelines feeding dashboards into a&nbsp;<strong>Modern Data Architecture</strong> environment.</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong><strong>Your Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Education</strong>: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, Computer Science, Data Engineering, AI/ML, Math or a highly quantitative field of study.</li> <li><strong>Leadership experience</strong> of 12+ years in data and software engineering environments, with at least 5 years in a senior manager or executive role leading cross-functional teams.</li> <li>Strong familiarity with <strong>core technical stack</strong> - cloud data ecosystems (eg. Snowflake, Databricks, Vertex AI, AWS Sagemaker).</li> <li>Experience moving to <strong>modern data architecture</strong> environment, with Deep Datawarehouse/lakehouse (AWS Redshift, Databricks), streaming/batch, APIs, data products, ELT, CDC, structured + unstructured data experience.</li> <li>Proven experience with <strong>AI/ML engineering</strong> and success deploying ML models into production, feature engineering, model serving, monitoring, MLOps.</li> <li>Exceptional ability to translate complex agentic systems, context-engineering strategies, and distributed database details into clear, business-relevant narratives for non-technical and executive boards.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) </strong></p> <p>We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day! </p> <p>We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals. </p> <p>Anaplan does not: &nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person. &nbsp;</li> <li>Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>All emails from Anaplan would come from an ----- email address. title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
description: <p><strong>THE POSITION</strong></p> <p>Our roster has an opening with your name on it</p> <p>Much of what decides whether a fan stays with FanDuel happens either side of the bet: the sign-up that takes a minute, the deposit that clears first time on a Sunday afternoon, the withdrawal that lands when we said it would, and the protections that work quietly in the background for the people who need them.</p> <p>We are looking for a Senior Staff Software Engineer to shape the technical direction of the systems behind that experience across FanDuel’s Customer Product Engineering (CPE) domain.</p> <p>CPE builds the systems fans touch first and trust most: payments and money movement, account and onboarding, geolocation, responsible gaming and player integrity, and the promotions, rewards and loyalty, campaign orchestration, personalisation and marketing messaging that shape every fan’s day-to-day experience. When CPE works, nobody notices. When it does not, a fan cannot get in, get funded, get paid or get looked after, and quality elsewhere in the product does not make up for it.</p> <p>The mission: make it quick and predictable for every fan to join, fund an account, get paid and be protected, in every jurisdiction we operate in, on the busiest day of the sporting calendar. Making every moment more, for our customers. Your work always follows our principle <em>Everything Begins with the Customer.</em></p> <p>That means designing for extreme, event-driven peak load, where traffic arrives in seconds, and for a heavily regulated environment in which auditability and evidence matter as much as availability. It also means depending on other people’s systems: payment providers, identity and KYC vendors, geolocation suppliers. You build so that their bad day does not become our customers’ bad day.</p> <p>This is a senior individual contributor role, at the same level as our Software Engineering Directors. You will own the technical strategy for a major part of CPE over a multi-year horizon, working alongside Directors and senior Product partners to work out what we build and what we stop. You will take on the questions with no obviously correct answer: where a capability belongs, which systems to retire, how money moves safely across providers, how to prove compliance without slowing delivery. A lot of this will not have been done here before, so a large part of the work is finding out what is true before the organisation commits to it.</p> <p>You are close to the code in your day-to-day, but most of your impact comes through other engineers: shaping designs, working the hardest incidents with the people closest to them, and growing the engineers moving into Staff and Senior Staff roles. You can trace a fan’s experience back through the stack to the decision that caused it, and you can explain a technical trade-off to an executive audience without diluting it.</p> <p>You are candid about what is not working, you seek out views that differ from your own, and when a call needs making you make it and help others get behind it, <em>Challenge and Commit.</em> You wear your FanDuel hat first and do not restrict yourself to organisational boundaries, <em>We are One Team.</em> You are a visible part of the domain leadership team and of our senior engineering community, and a role model to the wider engineering organisation, <em>Humble and Hungry.</em></p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>THE GAME PLAN</strong><br>Everyone on our team has a part to play</p> <ul> <li>Own the long-term technical strategy for your area of CPE, aligning the architecture of several teams with wider FanDuel initiatives and with the scale the business is heading towards.</li> <li>Start from the customer outcome and work back: registration and verification completion, time to first bet, deposit and withdrawal success rates, payout speed, geolocation pass rates, and the availability of whole journeys rather than the uptime of single services. Make sure our systems can measure these, and create new ways to measure and communicate customer impact where today’s fall short.</li> <li>Make the technical choices that have sweeping consequences across the domain, design the systems they call for in stages rather than as a single large bet, and bring engineers, managers and product partners with you.</li> <li>Architect for extreme, event-driven peak load and for third-party failure, so that capacity, failover and degradation behaviour are proven before the biggest days in the sporting calendar, and an outage at a payment, KYC or geolocation supplier does not reach customers.</li> <li>Treat regulation as an engineering requirement, building in auditability, evidence, data boundaries and jurisdictional variation from the start, and hold responsible gaming and player integrity systems to the same standard as any revenue-generating feature.</li> <li>Raise the operational bar across your area. Get hands-on with the most complex incidents, find the root cause, make sure corrective actions remove the class of failure rather than the instance, and support our software as part of an on-call rotation.</li> <li>Simplify the estate. Retire duplicated capability and unnecessary coupling, make considered build-versus-buy choices, and recognise waste in tooling, infrastructure, vendor services and payment processing costs.</li> <li>Set the standard for how AI is used across the software lifecycle in CPE, including where we choose not to use it, with evidence of the effect on throughput, quality and security and the judgement to tell real uplift from theatre.</li> <li>Partner with Product, Compliance, Risk, Finance and Customer Operations early to shape scope and trade-offs, spot the opportunities CPE’s capabilities open up, and help refocus work that is off course or not making a difference for customers.</li> <li>Coach and mentor engineers, particularly those growing into Staff and Senior Staff roles, spread knowledge through design reviews, talks and written documentation, and take part in hiring senior engineers and managers.</li> <li>Work with Principal Engineers and the wider senior engineering community to shape FanDuel-wide standards for architecture, tooling and engineering practice, and model a culture of quality, candour and collaboration.</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>THE STATS</strong></p> <p>What we’re looking for in our next teammate</p> <p>You don’t need all of these to apply, but they all count</p> <ul> <li>Several years as a Staff-level or more senior individual contributor, setting technical direction across multiple teams and bringing them with you through influence rather than authority.</li> <li>A track record of designing and running high-volume transactional systems in payments, financial services, identity or another regulated domain, with a deep grasp of the patterns that keep money and state correct, such as idempotency, reconciliation and event-driven architecture.</li> <li>Extensive experience with highly available, fault-tolerant distributed systems under extreme, event-driven peak load, including building on third parties at scale such as payment, KYC and geolocation providers.</li> <li>Experience designing systems where the answer was not yet known, using staged validation to reduce risk, and making pragmatic trade-offs between short-term needs and long-term health.</li> <li>Experience with observability and with using data and KPIs to guide engineering choices and hold systems to a measurable standard of availability and performance.</li> <li>Deep experience in modern back-end languages, functional and object-oriented, including Java, and with cloud infrastructure (preferably AWS), containers and orchestration.</li> <li>Hands-on understanding of AI-assisted software development, with a considered view of where it belongs in the lifecycle, where it does not, and what a regulated environment allows it to touch.</li> <li>Clear written and spoken communication, from crisp technical narratives that enable decisions to presenting at executive level.</li> <li>Degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.</li> </ul> <p><strong>THE CONTRACT</strong><br>We treat our team right</p> <p>Competitive compensation is just the beginning. As part of our team, you can expect:</p> <ul> <li>An exciting and fun environment committed to driving real growth</li> <li>Opportunities to build really cool products that fans love</li> <li>Mentorship and professional development resources to help you refine your game</li> <li>Flexible vacation allowance to let you refuel</li> <li>Hall of Fame benefit programs and platforms</li> </ul> <p><em>&nbsp;</em></p> <p><strong>ABOUT FANDUEL GROUP</strong></p> <p>FanDuel Group is a world-class team of brands and products all built with one goal in mind: to give fans new and innovative ways to interact with their favorite games, sports, teams, and leagues. That’s no easy task, which is why we’re so dedicated to building a winning team. And make no mistake, we are here to win, but we believe in winning right. That means we’ll never compromise when it comes to looking out for our teammates. From our many opportunities for professional development to our generous insurance and paid leave policies, we’re committed to making sure our employees get as much out of FanDuel as we ask them to give.</p> <p><strong>Our brands include:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>FanDuel Sportsbook</strong>: America’s #1 sports betting &amp; Prediction app</li> <li><strong>FanDuel DFS</strong>: A game-changing real-money fantasy sports app</li> <li><strong>FanDuel Racing</strong>: A horse racing app built for the average sports fan</li> <li><strong>FanDuel Casino &amp; Betfair Casino</strong>: Fan-favorite online casino apps</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Diversity, Equity and Inclusion</strong></p> <p><strong>We endeavour to make our interview process as accessible as possible. If you need any assistance prior to your interview, including any reasonable adjustments, please don't hesitate to get in touch.</strong></p> <p><em>FanDuel is an equal opportunities employer. Diversity and inclusion in FanDuel means that we respect and value everyone as individuals. We don't tolerate bias, judgement or harassment. Our focus is on developing employees so that they reach their full potential.</em></p> <p><strong>Location: Our Scottish tech hub is based in central Edinburgh and is fitted with fabulous amenities including a Gym, showers, bike parking, gaming pods, multiple breakout areas, meeting rooms, a roof terrace and much more. We operate a hybrid model, with at least two days in the office per week.</strong></p> <p><strong>The requirements listed in our job descriptions are guidelines, not hard and fast rules. You don’t have to satisfy every requirement or meet every qualification listed. If your skills are transferable and you are in the ballpark experience-wise, we'd love to speak to you.</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

  • New ledgers. Building the ledgers for Flexi-Loan and iwocaPay.

  • Account migration. Moving existing loan accounts onto the new ledgers with zero downtime and no data lost.

  • Credit card ledger. Building new features for the credit card ledger, from real-time card holds to daily interest and monthly statements.

  • Reconciliation and journals. Reconciling the ledger with banks, payment providers, and the card scheme, and producing the accounting journals Finance relies on.

  • Funding facilities. Recording how loans move between iwoca’s funding facilities.

title: Corporate Tax Services - Senior Manager
description: About CFGI:   Corporate Finance Group, Inc. (“CFGI”) was founded in 2000 by former Big 4 professionals. CFGI is an established industry leader with the resources to successfully navigate today’s complex accounting, reporting, compliance, and tax landscape. An assemblage of top-flight professionals with in-depth public accounting expertise, CFGI can fulfil a variety of client needs without the restrictions of auditor independence. With a foundation of knowledge amassed while serving a variety of industries, CFGI can guide companies through a wide range of routine and complex business scenarios. The resulting partnership is an innovative resource with the power to address our clients’ most crucial accounting, finance, and operational challenges.   We provide our clients with a unique combination of integrity, flexibility, creative solutions, and deep tax technical expertise. Many of our clients are global, market leading, publicly held companies, while others are privately held, early stage, or venture-backed emerging businesses. Here at CFGI, we place a high value on a culture of continued learning, where teamwork is encouraged, and professional excellence is rewarded.      Overview of role:   CFGI seeks a highly motivated tax manager to join its UK tax team. This role will provide a fantastic opportunity for an individual who is driven, entrepreneurial and constantly looking to challenge the status quo around the UK tax services industry.   You will be involved in all aspects of UK corporate tax (reporting, compliance, governance and advisory) and will have direct interaction with both our clients and senior members of the UK tax team in order to deliver these services.    1.      Client service delivery         a)      Tax reporting:   You will be involved in the delivery of UK tax reporting services to our diverse client base, which includes the following:   ·        UK publicly listed companies. ·        US headquartered multinationals (including US listed groups). ·        UK privately owned and private equity backed groups.   The exact scope of tax reporting work for our clients will vary but is likely to include the following:   ·        Preparation of UK entity only tax numbers in accordance with IFRS or UK GAAP. ·        Preparation of UK group tax numbers, likely to involve the incorporation of tax numbers for non-UK subsidiaries, GAAP-to GAAP adjustments (e.g. US GAAP to IFRS) and consolidation adjustments. ·        Advising on client’s tax reporting processes. ·        Advising on the tax aspects of GAAP conversion projects. ·        Advising on the tax reporting (and other) aspects of IPO readiness.   b)     UK corporation tax compliance:   You will be involved in the preparation and submission of UK corporation tax returns for our clients. This will involve you leading the day-to-day interaction with our clients to obtain all the information required to complete and file their returns in a timely manner. Whilst a formalized compliance process is in place, you will have a good degree of autonomy to manage the process in your own way, albeit with a focus on ensuring that our tax compliance offering is high quality, efficient and cost effective for our clients.   c)      Tax governance   You will be involved in the delivery of our tax governance proposition to clients, advising on tax strategy, risk management and controls.   d)     Tax advisory   You will be involved in tax advisory work likely to include the following:   ·        Ad hoc corporate tax advisory work originating from compliance engagements – e.g. loss planning and utilization, tax implications of trade and asset transfers, interest deductibility. ·        Cash tax modelling exercises. ·        Group simplification exercises. ·        Tax due diligence for client transactions. ·        Tax structuring for client transactions.   2.      Business development   As CFGI is looking to rapidly expand in the UK, there will be plenty of opportunity to get involved in business development activities, including the following:   ·        Assisting with the origination of tax opportunities on new and existing clients, drafting of proposals and involvement in the sales process (e.g. meetings, pitches, etc.). ·        Teaming with colleagues from other CFGI UK and US service areas (e.g. accounting advisory, business transformation) to identify and propose tax opportunities. ·        Teaming with the CFGI US tax team to support with and identify UK tax opportunities on US clients. ·        Identifying additional revenue streams with our clients.   Skills and Competencies:   Knowledge:   ·        Experience of UK tax reporting processes. ·        Knowledge of tax reporting IFRS and UK GAAP; high level understanding of US GAAP desired but not essential. ·        Experience of the UK tax return preparation process, and good technical understanding with common tax adjusting items such as capital allowances and other incentives, interest deductibility, hybrid mismatches, loss utilisation etc. ·        Experience of responding to and managing HMRC tax enquiries. ·        Knowledge / an appreciation of cross-border tax matters would be highly desirable, e.g. transfer pricing, country by country reporting etc.   Skills:   ·        Experienced with using Microsoft Excel and tax software packages i.e. OneSource. ·        Demonstrated ability to effectively present information and appropriately respond to questions from clients and team members. ·        Excellent organizational skills, ability to multi-task, and work under deadlines. ·        Excellent analytical, supervisory, organizational, and written and verbal communication skills are necessary. ·        Demonstrated ability to be accountable for independently completing assignments. ·        Capable of collaborating and communicating with people of different technical backgrounds and roles. ·        Analytical ability to navigate work-related situations with practicality, sound reasoning, and demonstrating creativity in problem solving. ·        Other key characteristics: the ideal candidate must demonstrate integrity and accountability, always remaining flexible, adaptable, and willing to accept coaching, building and managing professionally healthy relationships, and continually developing awareness of business-related topics. ·        As an entrepreneurial business you will be working with a growing team and with a range of service lines and so a desire to collaborate and work cross service line will be important.      Qualifications:   ·        Three to five years of corporate tax experience with some/all of this time ideally spent in the Big 4. ·        Professional accounting qualification (e.g. ACA, ACCA) required; additional tax qualification (e.g. CTA) strongly desired.     Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

CFGI seeks a highly motivated tax manager to join its UK tax team. This role will provide a fantastic opportunity for an individual who is driven, entrepreneurial and constantly looking to challenge the status quo around the UK tax services industry.
 
You will be involved in all aspects of UK corporate tax (reporting, compliance, governance and advisory) and will have direct interaction with both our clients and senior members of the UK tax team in order to deliver these services. 
 
1.     Client service delivery      
 
a)     Tax reporting:
 
You will be involved in the delivery of UK tax reporting services to our diverse client base, which includes the following:
 
·       UK publicly listed companies.
·       US headquartered multinationals (including US listed groups).
·       UK privately owned and private equity backed groups.
 
The exact scope of tax reporting work for our clients will vary but is likely to include the following:
 
·       Preparation of UK entity only tax numbers in accordance with IFRS or UK GAAP.
·       Preparation of UK group tax numbers, likely to involve the incorporation of tax numbers for non-UK subsidiaries, GAAP-to GAAP adjustments (e.g. US GAAP to IFRS) and consolidation adjustments.
·       Advising on client’s tax reporting processes.
·       Advising on the tax aspects of GAAP conversion projects.
·       Advising on the tax reporting (and other) aspects of IPO readiness.
 
b)    UK corporation tax compliance:
 
You will be involved in the preparation and submission of UK corporation tax returns for our clients. This will involve you leading the day-to-day interaction with our clients to obtain all the information required to complete and file their returns in a timely manner. Whilst a formalized compliance process is in place, you will have a good degree of autonomy to manage the process in your own way, albeit with a focus on ensuring that our tax compliance offering is high quality, efficient and cost effective for our clients.
 
c)     Tax governance
 
You will be involved in the delivery of our tax governance proposition to clients, advising on tax strategy, risk management and controls.
 
d)    Tax advisory
 
You will be involved in tax advisory work likely to include the following:
 
·       Ad hoc corporate tax advisory work originating from compliance engagements – e.g. loss planning and utilization, tax implications of trade and asset transfers, interest deductibility.
·       Cash tax modelling exercises.
·       Group simplification exercises.
·       Tax due diligence for client transactions.
·       Tax structuring for client transactions.
 
2.     Business development
 
As CFGI is looking to rapidly expand in the UK, there will be plenty of opportunity to get involved in business development activities, including the following:
 
·       Assisting with the origination of tax opportunities on new and existing clients, drafting of proposals and involvement in the sales process (e.g. meetings, pitches, etc.).
·       Teaming with colleagues from other CFGI UK and US service areas (e.g. accounting advisory, business transformation) to identify and propose tax opportunities.
·       Teaming with the CFGI US tax team to support with and identify UK tax opportunities on US clients.
·       Identifying additional revenue streams with our clients.
 
Skills and Competencies:
 
Knowledge:
 
·       Experience of UK tax reporting processes.
·       Knowledge of tax reporting IFRS and UK GAAP; high level understanding of US GAAP desired but not essential.
·       Experience of the UK tax return preparation process, and good technical understanding with common tax adjusting items such as capital allowances and other incentives, interest deductibility, hybrid mismatches, loss utilisation etc.
·       Experience of responding to and managing HMRC tax enquiries.
·       Knowledge / an appreciation of cross-border tax matters would be highly desirable, e.g. transfer pricing, country by country reporting etc.
 
Skills:
 
·       Experienced with using Microsoft Excel and tax software packages i.e. OneSource.
·       Demonstrated ability to effectively present information and appropriately respond to questions from clients and team members.
·       Excellent organizational skills, ability to multi-task, and work under deadlines.
·       Excellent analytical, supervisory, organizational, and written and verbal communication skills are necessary.
·       Demonstrated ability to be accountable for independently completing assignments.
·       Capable of collaborating and communicating with people of different technical backgrounds and roles.
·       Analytical ability to navigate work-related situations with practicality, sound reasoning, and demonstrating creativity in problem solving.
·       Other key characteristics: the ideal candidate must demonstrate integrity and accountability, always remaining flexible, adaptable, and willing to accept coaching, building and managing professionally healthy relationships, and continually developing awareness of business-related topics.
·       As an entrepreneurial business you will be working with a growing team and with a range of service lines and so a desire to collaborate and work cross service line will be important. 
 
 Qualifications:
 
·       Three to five years of corporate tax experience with some/all of this time ideally spent in the Big 4.
·       Professional accounting qualification (e.g. ACA, ACCA) required; additional tax qualification (e.g. CTA) strongly desired.

raw.description:
Are you ready to unleash your entrepreneurial spirit and be a part of an exciting start-up revolution as the main driver for its growth and success?

 

About us

United Media focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one. (Insurtech Insights, Presidents Summit, Private Equity Insights, HRtechX, CFO insights, Retail Insights and SetSales)

 

The Opportunity.

As a Entrepreneur In Residence, you will run, grow and manage all aspects of United Media. You will be responsible for building and leading a world-class team, ensuring the successful execution of the conference and strategy of the brand. 

You'll want this job if you possess strong leadership skills, excellent communication abilities, highly ambitious, forward-thinking and driven to inspire and lead a team. You are someone who is thrilled to work in a fast-paced environment and wants to scale the company rapidly.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Recruit, build and develop a high-performing team. 
  • Build an ecosystem and deliver outstanding products.
  • Set clear expectations, establish goals, and provide ongoing detailed feedback and performance evaluations.
  • Execute the strategy at a rapid pace.
  • Develop the company's brand as the go-to place for inspiration, knowledge and networking. 
  • Oversee planning, execution, and completion of conferences within the designated timelines and budget constraints.
  • Assign tasks to team members in each department, monitor progress, and ensure project objectives are achieved.
  • Identify opportunities to expand business with existing clients and collaborate with business development teams for new client acquisition.

 

What we offer you

You'll be working in person at our HQ in London (next to Sloane Square), constantly pushing you out of your comfort zone to ensure a never-ending growth curve for you and the business. We provide you with the following:

  • The opportunity to lead, run and develop a fast-growing business, where your work and the results are highly tangible and make all the difference. 
  • Work with an incredible team with a track record of developing and growing businesses. 
  • Travel opportunity: You will be joining our conferences overseas. 
  • Competitive salary

 

Requirement

  • +4 years' experience from an institution with high speed and work ethic e.g. management consulting, investment banking, top-tier corporate or start-up. 
  • Bachelor's degree with outstanding results, maybe followed by an MBA
  • Strong commercial awareness and a passion for business. 
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Proven track record delivering results.
  • UK, EU or US work permit

raw.title: Staff AI Engineer - Agent Evaluation Platform (x/f/m)
raw.description:
Join a team of passionate and hardworking entrepreneurs to transform healthcare!

 

Working in the tech team at Doctolib involves building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients. We work in feature teams in an agile environment, while collaborating with product, design, and business teams.

 

What you'll do

 

We are looking for a Staff AI Software Engineer to join the AI Evaluation team (EvalX) at Doctolib and help every AI product team measure, understand and improve the quality, reliability and safety of their systems.

 

Our AI products span patient-facing conversational agents, AI-powered phone assistants and clinical assistants supporting healthcare professionals. EvalX builds the platform, tools and methods that let these teams evaluate continuously, and our ambition is to make evaluation a core engineering practice.

 

In this role, you will work at the intersection of platform engineering, applied AI and product teams: you build shared evaluation capabilities, and you work directly with the teams that use them so they actually get adopted.

 

In this role, you will:

  • Design, ship, and operate production-grade evaluation tooling (APIs, services, CI/CD integrations) used by AI product teams across Doctolib

  • Work hands-on with product teams to assess how they evaluate today, define improvement plans, and help them own their evaluation quality

  • Design evaluation strategies for agentic systems, combining deterministic checks, LLM-as-a-judge, simulation-based testing, and human review

  • Build intelligent capabilities for production sampling, dataset representativeness monitoring, distribution-shift detection, and test case generation

  • Help teams define meaningful quality metrics, representative datasets, and reliable quality gates throughout the development lifecycle

  • Turn recurring product needs into reusable, self-service platform capabilities, and measure success through adoption, team autonomy, and evaluation coverage

  • Contribute to cross-functional initiatives that shape Doctolib's AI platform and best practices for building and evaluating agentic systems

 

Who you are

 

Before you read on, if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply! You could be our next team mate if you:

  • Have 6+ years of experience as a software engineer, with significant experience using Python; or as a machine learning engineer

  • Have built or operated evaluation for LLM-powered or agentic systems: datasets, LLM-as-a-judge, human review, production-driven evaluation

  • Understand and promote software development best practices

  • Are product-oriented and enjoy working directly with other teams, challenging assumptions, and turning complex needs into concrete solutions

  • Can influence engineering practices and drive change without hierarchical authority: your job is not done until your solution is adopted

  • Are comfortable speaking and writing in English in your day-to-day with the team

 

Now, it would be fantastic if you:

  • Have experience with applied ML techniques such as embeddings, clustering, statistical sampling, and distribution monitoring

  • Have experience building developer platforms or internal tooling, or in a Forward Deployed Engineering role

  • Have experience in the medical domain or another regulated environment

 

What we offer

  • Free comprehensive health insurance (basic package) for you and your children

  • 25 days of paid vacation per year, plus up to 14 days of RTT

  • Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care

  • Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy

  • Lunch vouchers (Swile card) worth €8.50 per working day, with €4.50 covered by Doctolib

  • A subsidy from the work council to refund part of the membership to a sport club or a creative class

  • 50% reimbursement of your public transport subscription

  • Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth

  • ParentCare Program: Enjoy full salary coverage (100%) during your first month of birth leave, and 75% during the second, covered by Doctolib

  • For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support

 

The interview process

  • A first interview with a member of the Talent Acquisition team

  • A coding interview

  • An agentics system design

  • A behavioural interview

  • Reference check

 

Job details

  • Permanent position

  • Full Time

  • Workplace: Levallois

Pourquoi ce poste ?

Octopus Energy France connaît une forte croissance sur ses segments B2C, B2B et B2G, et sa fonction Finance se structure en parallèle : migration récente d’Odoo vers NetSuite, automatisation de la chaîne fournisseurs, interfaçage avec les plateformes de facturation, harmonisation avec les standards du groupe au Royaume-Uni. Nous cherchons un·e comptable senior capable de prendre en main un périmètre critique (marge brute et fiscalité énergie), de le fiabiliser et de le faire évoluer. Plus qu’un·e exécutant·e, tu seras celui ou celle qui identifie les problèmes, en comprend la cause et met en place des solutions durables.

Gross margin et comptabilité énergie
  • Piloter la comptabilisation mensuelle des flux de marge brute (achats d’énergie, acheminement, ventes facturées et non facturées) et en produire une analyse critique : variations, écarts, leviers
  • Fiabiliser le cut-off et les estimations de fin de mois (factures à établir, énergie livrée non facturée, provisions), en lien avec les équipes opérationnelles et facturation
  • Justifier et documenter les comptes de ton périmètre, et traiter les anomalies jusqu’à leur résolution définitive
    • Fiscalité énergie et TVA
  • Établir, contrôler et déposer les déclarations de TVA (CA3) ainsi que les accises sur l’électricité et le gaz naturel et la CTA
  • Établir les déclarations d’échanges de biens (EMEBI) sur les flux intra-UE
  • Être l’interlocuteur·trice de référence sur les questions fiscales du périmètre : analyser les cas nouveaux (offres commerciales, programmes de fidélité, nouveaux produits), formaliser une position et la challenger avec nos conseils externes
  • Contribuer à la mise en conformité avec la réforme de la facturation électronique et du e-reporting
    • Supervision et contrôle
  • Superviser et contrôler les opérations de la comptabilité fournisseurs, et contribuer à l’amélioration de la chaîne d’automatisation (NetSuite, Rossum)
  • Être l’interlocuteur·trice des commissaires aux comptes et des auditeurs sur ton périmètre : préparation des justificatifs, réponses aux demandes, suivi des recommandations
    • Structuration et amélioration continue
  • Identifier les points de friction dans les clôtures et les process, proposer des solutions et les mettre en œuvre
  • Raccourcir et fiabiliser les clôtures mensuelles post-migration NetSuite
  • Rédiger et maintenir la documentation des process et des contrôles

    • Au-delà de 6 mois :

  • Tu maitrises le Français et l'Anglais professionnel (niveau B2-C1): tu échangeras régulièrement avec les équipes du groupe au Royaume-Uni

  • Tu es un·e vrai problem solver : face à un écart inexpliqué, tu ne te contentes pas de le corriger, tu remontes à la cause et tu fais en sorte qu’il ne se reproduise pas
  • Tu es à l’aise dans un environnement en construction, où tout n’est pas encore documenté, et tu aimes structurer

title: Head of Cybersecurity
description: About Us KIDAN is a fast-growing, family-owned IT consulting company headquartered in Switzerland, serving nearly 1'000 enterprise clients. Since 2020, we’ve been helping businesses turn IT into a strategic advantage through smart, secure, and scalable solutions. We specialize in IT management and security, and we are the exclusive Swiss distributor of ManageEngine, with strong partnerships including Cloudflare, Colortokens, SentinelOne, Zoho, Horizon3, Quest, and others. Our team of international experts is driven by excellence, integrity, and a people-first mindset. At KIDAN, we don’t just solve IT problems—we enable long-term business success. Be part of a mission where technology drives progress and people lead the way. Job Description Key Responsibilities 1. Own KIDAN's Cybersecurity Posture Own KIDAN's overall cybersecurity posture, strategy, policies, standards and roadmap. Ensure cybersecurity is embedded across KIDAN's technology, operations and internal environment. Identify and challenge cyber risks, gaps and priorities, and drive corrective actions. Own cybersecurity compliance and support certifications and frameworks such as ISO 27001. Work closely with Technology, Operations and leadership to ensure cybersecurity is built into how KIDAN operates. Be technically involved in assessing KIDAN's cybersecurity architecture, technologies, configurations, controls and implementations. Regularly go beyond governance and documentation to validate that cyber controls are actually implemented and working effectively in practice. 2. Provide Hands-On Technical Cybersecurity Leadership Act as a technical cybersecurity leader who can get into the field and work directly with technical teams. Review and challenge cybersecurity architectures, technical designs, configurations, implementations and controls. Participate directly in complex cyber investigations, incident response, escalations and technical problem-solving when required. Work alongside engineers, cybersecurity specialists and SOC analysts to solve complex cyber challenges and improve technical capabilities. Maintain a strong understanding of the technologies, tools and platforms used across KIDAN's cybersecurity environment. Be able to independently understand and assess technical cyber issues rather than relying exclusively on the team for technical interpretation. Set the technical standard for the cybersecurity organization and continuously raise the team's technical maturity. Remain sufficiently hands-on to maintain technical credibility with both internal teams and enterprise customers. 3. Own & Develop the Cybersecurity Offering Own the strategy, quality and relevance of KIDAN's cybersecurity offering. Continuously challenge and improve our cybersecurity services, capabilities and value proposition. Ensure our SOC and cybersecurity services (e.g. detection and response, threat intelligence, vulnerability management, cyber resilience) are technically strong, operationally mature and aligned with enterprise customer needs. Stay close to the actual delivery of our cybersecurity services and understand how our offerings are implemented in real customer environments. Work with the commercial and technology teams to identify opportunities to grow KIDAN's cybersecurity business and revenue. Ensure what we sell is what we can genuinely deliver at a high standard. Participate in the design and evolution of cybersecurity solutions, architectures and service models. Support the team in complex technical customer opportunities where senior cybersecurity expertise is required. 4. Challenge Cybersecurity Delivery Ensure cybersecurity services and projects are delivered to a consistently high standard. Stay close to delivery and regularly engage with the teams doing the technical work. Challenge processes, technical decisions, architecture and delivery quality where cybersecurity standards are not met. Review technical deliverables and cybersecurity implementations where appropriate. Oversee the SOC team and ensure strong operational performance, processes, quality and continuous improvement. Establish clear cybersecurity KPIs, controls and quality standards. Step into critical delivery, technical escalations or cyber incidents when the situation requires senior technical expertise. Ensure lessons from cyber incidents, projects and customer engagements are translated into improvements across the cybersecurity function. 5. Enterprise Customer & Cybersecurity Escalation Point Act as a senior cybersecurity point of contact for key enterprise customers. Be comfortable going into customer environments and engaging directly with technical teams, cybersecurity teams, IT leaders and executives. Lead or support customer discussions around cybersecurity strategy, architecture, compliance, cyber risk and major requirements. Participate in technical workshops, cyber risk assessments, architecture discussions and complex customer engagements. Act as the escalation point for critical cybersecurity topics, incidents and customer concerns. Be able to discuss technical cybersecurity topics at depth with experienced customer cyber and IT professionals. Build trust with customers by bringing strong technical expertise, credibility and business understanding. 6. Cybersecurity Leadership & Governance Establish clear cybersecurity governance, ownership and decision-making across KIDAN. Ensure cyber risks are visible and appropriately escalated to leadership. Partner with Technology, Compliance, Operations and other functions on cybersecurity priorities and risk management. Lead, coach and develop the cybersecurity team, creating a culture of technical excellence, ownership and continuous improvement. raw.description:
About Us

KIDAN is a fast-growing, family-owned IT consulting company headquartered in Switzerland, serving nearly 1'000 enterprise clients. Since 2020, we’ve been helping businesses turn IT into a strategic advantage through smart, secure, and scalable solutions.

We specialize in IT management and security, and we are the exclusive Swiss distributor of ManageEngine, with strong partnerships including Cloudflare, Colortokens, SentinelOne, Zoho, Horizon3, Quest, and others. Our team of international experts is driven by excellence, integrity, and a people-first mindset.

At KIDAN, we don’t just solve IT problems—we enable long-term business success.

Be part of a mission where technology drives progress and people lead the way.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

1. Own KIDAN's Cybersecurity Posture

  • Own KIDAN's overall cybersecurity posture, strategy, policies, standards and roadmap.

  • Ensure cybersecurity is embedded across KIDAN's technology, operations and internal environment.

  • Identify and challenge cyber risks, gaps and priorities, and drive corrective actions.

  • Own cybersecurity compliance and support certifications and frameworks such as ISO 27001.

  • Work closely with Technology, Operations and leadership to ensure cybersecurity is built into how KIDAN operates.

  • Be technically involved in assessing KIDAN's cybersecurity architecture, technologies, configurations, controls and implementations.

  • Regularly go beyond governance and documentation to validate that cyber controls are actually implemented and working effectively in practice.

2. Provide Hands-On Technical Cybersecurity Leadership

  • Act as a technical cybersecurity leader who can get into the field and work directly with technical teams.

  • Review and challenge cybersecurity architectures, technical designs, configurations, implementations and controls.

  • Participate directly in complex cyber investigations, incident response, escalations and technical problem-solving when required.

  • Work alongside engineers, cybersecurity specialists and SOC analysts to solve complex cyber challenges and improve technical capabilities.

  • Maintain a strong understanding of the technologies, tools and platforms used across KIDAN's cybersecurity environment.

  • Be able to independently understand and assess technical cyber issues rather than relying exclusively on the team for technical interpretation.

  • Set the technical standard for the cybersecurity organization and continuously raise the team's technical maturity.

  • Remain sufficiently hands-on to maintain technical credibility with both internal teams and enterprise customers.

3. Own & Develop the Cybersecurity Offering

  • Own the strategy, quality and relevance of KIDAN's cybersecurity offering.

  • Continuously challenge and improve our cybersecurity services, capabilities and value proposition.

  • Ensure our SOC and cybersecurity services (e.g. detection and response, threat intelligence, vulnerability management, cyber resilience) are technically strong, operationally mature and aligned with enterprise customer needs.

  • Stay close to the actual delivery of our cybersecurity services and understand how our offerings are implemented in real customer environments.

  • Work with the commercial and technology teams to identify opportunities to grow KIDAN's cybersecurity business and revenue.

  • Ensure what we sell is what we can genuinely deliver at a high standard.

  • Participate in the design and evolution of cybersecurity solutions, architectures and service models.

  • Support the team in complex technical customer opportunities where senior cybersecurity expertise is required.

  • Ensure cybersecurity services and projects are delivered to a consistently high standard.

  • Stay close to delivery and regularly engage with the teams doing the technical work.

  • Challenge processes, technical decisions, architecture and delivery quality where cybersecurity standards are not met.

  • Review technical deliverables and cybersecurity implementations where appropriate.

  • Oversee the SOC team and ensure strong operational performance, processes, quality and continuous improvement.

  • Establish clear cybersecurity KPIs, controls and quality standards.

  • Step into critical delivery, technical escalations or cyber incidents when the situation requires senior technical expertise.

  • Ensure lessons from cyber incidents, projects and customer engagements are translated into improvements across the cybersecurity function.

  • Act as a senior cybersecurity point of contact for key enterprise customers.

  • Be comfortable going into customer environments and engaging directly with technical teams, cybersecurity teams, IT leaders and executives.

  • Lead or support customer discussions around cybersecurity strategy, architecture, compliance, cyber risk and major requirements.

  • Participate in technical workshops, cyber risk assessments, architecture discussions and complex customer engagements.

  • Act as the escalation point for critical cybersecurity topics, incidents and customer concerns.

  • Be able to discuss technical cybersecurity topics at depth with experienced customer cyber and IT professionals.

  • Build trust with customers by bringing strong technical expertise, credibility and business understanding.

6. Cybersecurity Leadership & Governance

  • Establish clear cybersecurity governance, ownership and decision-making across KIDAN.

  • Ensure cyber risks are visible and appropriately escalated to leadership.

  • Partner with Technology, Compliance, Operations and other functions on cybersecurity priorities and risk management.

  • Lead, coach and develop the cybersecurity team, creating a culture of technical excellence, ownership and continuous improvement.

  • Fluent in French and English.

  • German is a strong advantage.

Du verstehst klinische, pflegerische oder administrative Abläufe und erkennst, wo digitale Lösungen im Alltag einen Mehrwert schaffen. Du bringst Erfahrung im Produktmanagement, Business Development, Lösungsvertrieb oder in einer vergleichbaren Funktion an der Schnittstelle zwischen Gesundheitswesen, ICT und Markt mit. Du kannst verkaufen: Du erkennst Kundenbedürfnisse, formulierst überzeugende Nutzenargumente und begeisterst unterschiedliche Anspruchsgruppen für eine Lösung. Du trittst sicher auf und präsentierst gerne – im persönlichen Kundengespräch ebenso wie in Workshops oder vor einem grösseren Publikum. Du kannst Kampagnen und Ergebnisse fachlich beurteilen und die Arbeit einer Agentur oder eines Spezialisten steuern. Erfahrung mit Analytics und Tracking, zum Beispiel GA4 und Google Tag Manager (idealerweise auch Google Search Console). Ein gutes Gespür für klare Kommunikation, Content und vertrauensbildende Kundenerlebnisse. Erfahrung mit CRM, WhatsApp-Marketing oder Remarketing ist ein Plus. Eine selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie Freude daran, Ideen teamübergreifend bis zur Umsetzung zu begleiten.
